title: Jackal Steal The Ball At The Breakdown (Chas McIvor)
style: country swing bluegrass banjo brass bongo fast beat 134bpm comedy dad voice spoken interjections southern drawl harmonica fiddle
lyrics:
[Intro - Chas spoken]
I say son, the jackal wins the turnover
First over the ball, hands on, lift
Win the penalty or steal the ball clean

[Verse 1]
The tackle is made, the carrier is down
First defender on the scene, claim the crown
Feet on the ground, both hands on the ball
Knees off the ground, balanced and tall

[Pre-Chorus]
Lift the ball with the back arched and strong
Both feet planted, never go wrong
If you go off your feet, you lose the call
Stay on the feet, son, win the brawl

[Chorus]
Jackal steal the ball at the breakdown, son
First on the scene, the work begun
Feet on the ground, hands on the ball
Lift it clean, son, win the call

[Verse 2]
Three seconds is all you have, son
Before the cleanout arrives, the work undone
Quick hands on the ball, quick lift
If the ref says release, drop it swift

[Bridge - Chas spoken]
I say boy, the seven and the openside flanker
Live on the breakdown, the jackal banker
Never stop hunting the ball, every ruck
Winning turnovers wins games, son, no luck

[Chorus]
Jackal steal the ball at the breakdown, son
First on the scene, the work begun
Feet on the ground, hands on the ball
Lift it clean, son, win the call

[Outro]
First on, feet planted
Hands on ball, never panted
Three seconds, lift it clean
Thats my boy, the jackal scene
